charts.title: K2-162 b: orbits around K2-162
charts.description: The orbits of K2-162's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-162 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Livingston et al. 2018 (2018AJ....156...78L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LIVINGSTON_ET_AL__2018): P 9.45889 d

charts.title: K2-162 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-162 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (46, 91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 94892940, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 12 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 1231 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 12 min late; 12-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 410 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
